figurative_meaning_en: To be accepted with reverence and respect
similar_in_english: I'll take it as a badge of honor
example_sentences_in_english: I accept your command with reverence.
This decision is binding on me with utmost respect.
history: Derived from Sanskrit roots, symbolizing the highest form of honor by metaphorically placing something on one's head, common in classical Indian literature and formal Bengali usage.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Indian cultural norms of hierarchical respect.
